evidence_quote: Increases in energy efﬁciency and can be achieved by automated data analysis and by presenting the user energy performance indicators of all relevant HVAC components.
The main focus of the work in this paper is the automatic detection of duty cycles in adsorption chillers by using the X-Means algorithm.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: EnPI mention is incidental; the X-Means model classifies chiller duty-cycle and system states rather than measuring or normalising energy performance.

paper_type.evidence_quote: In this study, we use the data collected from the meters associated to the chiller where we obtained 4-minute interval and hourly temperature and energy values, respectively.

stage1.notes: The abstract mentions energy performance indicators, but the paper does not identify or characterise an EnPI/EnB measurement model.
